scope: Bounded review of PR_BODY.md and REVIEW.md against actual preservation, validation, six review records and Suggested.lean. No new mathematical review or core edits.

findings.title: Make PR-body evidence links independent of the Markdown file directory
findings.initial_issue: Four sibling-relative links to REVIEW.md, validation.json, preservation.json and dependency_audit.json were valid in PR_BODY.md as a repository file but did not carry the reports/submission directory context when copied into a pull-request description. The phrase "six records in this directory" had the same problem.
findings.correction_verified: All evidence links are now absolute URLs to the actual fork submission branch and corresponding repository path. The six review records are referenced through REVIEW.md, whose relative links all resolve locally. The workflow alignment link is also absolute. The misleading directory phrase is removed.
findings.limit: URL structure and actual local target files were verified. Remote HTTP availability is not asserted before the submission branch is committed and pushed.
